The main takeaway from our work is that

a comprehensive vulnerability repository should have the following characteristics: (i) it should capture the most prevalent vulnerabilities in the target platform; (ii) it should be up-to-date, i.e. it should be continuously updated with the latest vulnerabilities; (iii) it should be lean, i.e. the benchmarks should not contain any irrelevant code; and (iv) it should be easy to use.
